source.claim: Slearn is organized by perspectival curvature under translational limits, not by a finished answer or a free navigation scheme.

observation: A relation may be read from a local perspective and a goal/global orientation without privileging an origin language.
perspective: A current local reading whose available paths can change.
beliefLimit: A value or belief constrains what is relevant, possible, or obstructed.
goalLimit: A direction constrains and pulls possible paths without validating its own path.
why: A reason joining the current perspective, its limits, and a possible direction.

explanations.semantic: A semantic explanation is one presentation of the reason.
explanations.operative: An operative explanation exposes the same reason through definition, lesson, test, or project.

definition: Language and definition may exchange roles while the declared relation is preserved.

paths.forward: Perspective → WHY → goal is a declared forward path.
paths.counter: A dual, limiting, or obstructed path remains part of the same comparison rather than an unrelated operator.

translation.forwardBridge: The WHY relation translates the local presentation toward the goal/global reading.
translation.inverseBridge: The same declared relation re-reads the goal/global presentation as a local perspective.
translation.witnessLanguage: The declared comparison relation is the witness language for relative closure.

admission.condition: A relative presentation may continue only after its counter-reading and declared comparison are carried into a further relation.
